reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in the DM. He's set: Maren Tolland is noted as his go-to escalation contact at Tansley Parcel for the Linden rollout.

The brain had already saved his message automatically as a fact, limited to him, and a search with his name and "Tansley Parcel Linden" brings it up. I didn't save a second copy with the brain's own save tool. That tool doesn't show who could see a new entry, so it could have made a DM-only note visible to other people.

The saved note isn't tagged to a person or company, so a search that doesn't use the note's own wording might not find it.
